messages.text: Thursday, September 24 · Canton, Michigan
Autumn's first crisp air, jazz notes, and a town's future
A mostly clear Thursday arrives with crisp autumn air and a high near 70°F. Look for jazz performances in Ann Arbor and discussions on Ann Arbor's downtown property sale.
Expect a mostly clear day with a high near 70°F and a low around 51°F, with no chance of precipitation.
Sunrise is at 7:24 AM and sunset is at 7:27 PM, with the moon appearing as a waxing gibbous, 93.4% illuminated.
Ann Arbor's evening sounds and sights
For a taste of jazz, consider Fresh Berrys. at El Limon at 6:00 PM, or Pianist Barron Ryan at Kerrytown Concert House at 7:30 PM.
Evil Gigawatt's birthday is today, September 24.
Ann Arbor plans for downtown property sale funds
Ann Arbor City Council has approved a spending plan for the $14.2 million to $17.4 million expected from the sale of the city-owned Kline’s lot. The funds will be allocated to 12 different projects.
Friday brings film and music
Tomorrow, catch a free outdoor screening of 'Best in Show' at Campus Martius Park in Detroit, or attend Dolly Day at the Ann Arbor District Library.
Satellites navigate without GPS, new cancer treatment advances

NASA's Starling satellites have demonstrated GPS-free autonomous navigation using onboard cameras and star catalogs. The University of Michigan has established a $10 million Histotripsy Center to advance non-invasive cancer treatments using soundwaves.
The Starship launch schedule is unset, with no official date listed for its next attempt.
A clear sky offers many paths to discovery.
Friday, September 25 · Canton, Michigan
Overcast skies meet a full moon's glow
An overcast day in Canton will feel mild, with a high near 69°F. Tonight, the nearly full moon offers a bright backdrop to local music and arts events across the region.
Expect an overcast day with a high near 69°F and a low around 46°F; the chance of precipitation is minimal.
Sunrise is at 7:25 AM and sunset at 7:26 PM, with the nearly full moon shining at 97.6% illumination.
Arts and music fill the evening

In Ann Arbor, pianist Barron Ryan blends classical and cool jazz at 6:30 PM at the Kerrytown Concert House. For a free community gathering, the Ann Arbor District Library hosts Dolly Day with crafts and music videos starting at 5:30 PM.
The next full moon is expected tomorrow, September 26.
Ann Arbor allocates funds from downtown property sale

Ann Arbor City Council has approved a spending plan for the expected $14.2 million to $17.4 million from the sale of the Kline’s lot. The funds will support 12 different projects, including affordable housing and sustainable energy initiatives.
Tomorrow offers diverse local events

In Ypsilanti, the Big Read kicks off at 11 AM with performances and speakers, and Spinning Dot Theatre presents "Mariposa/Butterfly" at 2 PM. Detroit offers a free outdoor film screening of "Best in Show" at Campus Martius Park at 7 PM.
Satellites navigate without GPS, Roman telescope clears review

NASA's Starling satellites have demonstrated GPS-free autonomous navigation using onboard cameras and star catalogs. The Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope has also cleared its flight-readiness review and is proceeding to final launch preparations.
The schedule for Starship Flight 14 has not been officially announced by SpaceX, with independent estimates suggesting no earlier than September 18, 2026.
Let the evening's offerings be a gentle guide.
